content: Across minimalist journaling apps (Day One, Journey, Diarium, Stoic, Obsidian daily notes), common differentiating axes are: markdown support, cross-platform reach (esp. Windows), reminders/nudges, templates/prompts, and export to PDF/Markdown/plain text. Diarium and Stoic emphasize gentle streak/reminder habit-formation; Obsidian differentiates on being a full local markdown vault rather than a dedicated journal app.
